message: No detected input validation: The code performs column renaming and type casting but does not validate schema, check for required columns, assert dtypes, or guard value ranges on the ingested data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from local CSV files ('train.csv', 'test.csv') with no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on the files.
No detected label flipping detection: The code never validates label values, checks label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples on the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using scikit-learn and does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is performed or needed.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, label set validity, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the code.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads CSV data and applies one-hot encoding but performs no shape checks, range validation, schema enforcement, or rejection of malformed inputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a tabular ML classifier (SVM/GridSearchCV), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
